newsitem.title: GERMANY: BV ups Heidelberger Zement EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: BV ups Heidelberger Zement EPS forecasts.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank on Thursday raised its 1996 EPS outlook for German cement company Heidelberger Zement AG to 7.20 marks from 6.90, and held its recommendation at "market neutral".
Vereinsbank said it had raised its EPS forecast because changes in Heidel Zement's group structure would mean less of a payout from earnings to third parties, the analysts said.
The bank has lowered its 1997 EPS outlook to seven marks from 7.20 marks, based on the sluggish outlook for the German market next year.
Vereinsbank analysts were expecting the effects of consolidation to hit sales in the full year and the analysts forecasts a rise of 1.5 percent to 6.13 billion marks in sales.
